resource: Movement step inputs applied for one actor in one Channel owner work cycle
unit: step inputs per actor per work cycle
allocation_impact: At most one step input is applied per actor per Channel owner work cycle; further inputs remain outstanding FND-02 commands bounded by FND02-OUTSTANDING-COMMANDS, processed FIFO per session and round-robin across actors.
boundary_tests: max=1: one step input for an actor is applied in a work cycle
max+1=2: a second step input for the same actor is not applied in the same work cycle; it stays outstanding and the 65th outstanding command is refused under the existing FND-02 rule
consumers: first connected Movement child: own-actor cardinal step (FIRST-CONTROL-WIRE-V1)
notes: Accepted by the resource owner in #139 comment 5853424970 (FIRST-CONTROLLED-STEP-LIMITS-V1). Speed and timing semantics are not decided; occupancy, visibility, relocation, Interaction and pathfinding rows are fail-closed exclusions in this child.
